$comment: One proposed or decided index heading in a Manuscript Index Builder Index_Map. The heading is a proposal until the author accepts it; `accepted_hash` binds the acceptance to the heading's content (sha256 of the canonical JSON of the heading minus status, accepted_hash and weight), so any later change re-opens it. `anchors` are verbatim single-line quotes proven to occur exactly once in the map's snapshot; `role` passing never becomes a locator. `subheadings` are one level deep. `see` and `see_also` hold heading ids. The subset engine checks the top-level fields; scripts/book_index.py checks the nested anchor and subheading rules, the See-only shape, provenance (I2), cross-references (I3) and acceptance (I4). See docs/manuscript-indexing.md.
